# Open Doodles license evidence

Open Doodles is the original illustration collection by Pablo Stanley. Its official about page says these works may be copied, edited, remixed, shared, and redrawn for any purpose under CC0. The official collection says it is free for commercial and personal use with no credit required.

- Official terms and authorship: https://www.opendoodles.com/about
- Official collection and downloadable SVG links: https://www.opendoodles.com/
- CC0 1.0 deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Original SVGs and item metadata: source/ and asset-manifest.json
